payload.text: `settlement_round_trips` pins the wire↔types Settlement conversion as a total round-trip: for every `celnet_types::Settlement` variant (Deliverable, NonDeliverable) `Settlement::from(WireSettlement::from(s)) == s`. It guards that the two `From` directions remain mutually inverse so the deliverable/non-deliverable (NDO cash-settled) distinction survives a wire encode/decode unchanged — the single-contract guarantee for the settlement convention. Pure test: constructs values and asserts equality, no external mutation.
